summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce the completion of its combined 2026-2027 reinsurance program for its insurance subsidiaries. The filing details retention levels, tower limits, reinstatement provisions, and Florida Hurricane Catastrophe Fund coverage elections. There are no special-situation M&A, restructuring, or activist elements. This is a routine operational update on catastrophe reinsurance placements.
